title: the Ninefold Court Rising Again
author: Jude Almeida
blurb: Quentin Lockridge, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
